objective: Generate review-only memory consolidation proposals (cluster exact-duplicate accepted memory items; propose keep-canonical + supersede-duplicates) for human review; never auto-delete/supersede/merge memory.

summary.migrator_change: None — reuses the reserved V38 second_brain_memory_consolidation_candidates + _review_items tables (present at V39). This change adds NO tables.
summary.reuse: memory/store.write_memory_item (proof fixtures), the statement-hashing concept from memory/quality_review.py (Prompt 30), the eval_set.py persister pattern.

design.clustering: Group accepted items (review_status='accepted') by (project_key, memory_type, sha256(statement_redacted)). A cluster is >= min_cluster_size (2) exact-duplicate items. Oldest member (created_utc, memory_id) = canonical keep; rest = proposed supersede. Statements + memory ids are SHA256-hashed (never raw).
design.review_only: Proposals only — never auto-deletes/supersedes/merges. long_term_memory_items is left byte-for-byte unchanged. Proposals persist (on emit_receipt) to consolidation_candidates (per cluster) + consolidation_review_items (per member, advisory_only=1, review_status='pending_review', review_tier='mandatory_review'). makes_determination=false.
design.read_only: emit_receipt defaults False (no operator-DB write); reads accepted items via mode=ro SQL.

operator_db_outcome.rationale: The operator DB has 0 accepted long_term_memory_items -> no duplicate clusters -> honestly empty. emit_receipt defaulted False -> nothing persisted.
